findings.description: Plan claimed appendLog can never throw, but appendLog (mailbox.js:926-938) runs getLogPath/ensureDir OUTSIDE its try/catch. A new appendLog call after the mailbox write could turn an observability failure into a caller-visible send failure, violating no-behavior-change.
findings.resolution: Verified in source (mailbox.js:927-928). Added a mandatory own try/catch wrap around the change-2 appendLog call site, a Best-effort guard note in Architecture, a Risk Areas entry, and a failure-seam acceptance criterion.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap the new mail-queued-no-listener appendLog call in its own try/catch; add a failure-seam test.

findings.description: Claude (High) + Copilot (Medium) + Codex (Medium): US-003 tested only the helpers + queued line, not the two listener-loop log enrichments. An implementer could omit timeoutMs/armedAtAgeMs/oldestMsgAgeMs and still pass.
findings.resolution: US-003 and the ACs now require deterministic listener-loop tests (subprocess or injected-IO) asserting the delivered (initial) and timeout crews.log fields, with stdout key-set unchanged, mirroring tests/listener.test.js / dispatcher-arm-listener.test.js.
findings.suggestedFix: Add initial-delivery + explicit-timeout subprocess tests asserting the new crews.log fields.

findings.description: The Appendix-A task() handoff pointed at plugins/ralph/.copilot-plugin/internal-workflows/implement-with-ralph/SKILL.md which does not exist in this checkout (actual: plugins/ralph/skills/... and .copilot-plugin/copilot-skills/...). Would block an autonomous implementer using the plan verbatim.
findings.resolution: Rewrote Next Step to the engine-resolved /implement-with-ralph --from-plan slash handoff (lead spawns impl member), removing the broken hardcoded internal-workflow path; added the submodule-target + two-commit flow note.
findings.suggestedFix: Use the /implement-with-ralph --from-plan slash form instead of the broken task() path.

findings.description: Verification commands mixed cwd assumptions (node tests/run.js vs node plugins/crews/tests/run.js vs node --check plugins/crews/...). Not directly runnable as written.
findings.resolution: Added an explicit cwd convention (commands run from ai-developer-toolkit/plugins/crews unless stated; bump-version.js from ai-developer-toolkit). Rewrote every command in Implementation Strategy + ACs with the correct cwd.

findings.description: US-004 bundled submodule release edits with codexu wrapper pointer/table edits; repo rules require a submodule-first commit then a separate codexu pointer/table commit.
findings.resolution: Split US-004 into member-owned submodule version/CHANGELOG/AGENTS work (step 4) and a separate lead-owned ship-steps block (step 5) for the codexu active-plugin-versions table + submodule gitlink. Mirrored in the Preliminary Story Decomposition and Next Step.
findings.suggestedFix: Separate member-owned submodule work from lead-owned ship steps.

findings.description: Claude + Codex (+ self Q1): raw manifest.listenerState !== 'armed' is wrong in both directions for a 'mail-queued-no-listener' diagnostic — misses stale-armed (dead listener) and false-positives on legacy timestamp-only manifests that derive to armed.
findings.resolution: Flipped the primary predicate to deriveListenerState(manifest) !== 'armed' (lazy require './actor-state' for the cycle). Updated Architecture, Risk Areas (cheap isProcessAlive only on live-armed branch), ACs (each branch incl. stale-armed via heartbeat-staleness), and resolved Q1.
findings.suggestedFix: Use deriveListenerState; document the deliberate deviation from the seed's literal wording.

findings.description: Copilot + Codex: 'stdout JSON envelope byte-unchanged' is too literal — the timeout envelope already carries dynamic waitedMs.
findings.resolution: Rephrased the AC structurally: no new stdout keys, none removed, no message body added to {type:'messages'}; existing dynamic fields unchanged in shape.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the stdout-unchanged AC structural (key-set), not byte-literal.

findings.description: e2e AC only exercised appendMailbox + appendSystemMailbox; appendOperatorMailbox (also routes through the chokepoint) was uncovered — a duplicated-logging mistake could pass tests while operator-direct messages miss the diagnostic.
findings.resolution: Added appendOperatorMailbox to the e2e coverage AC, with the alternative of a source-level assertion that the log line exists only inside appendMailboxWithSender.
findings.suggestedFix: Add an appendOperatorMailbox case or a single-call-site source assertion.

findings.description: Claude (Medium) + Copilot (Low): helper export scope + version rationale ambiguous. The 3.11.0 argument rested on 'new public exports', but the public surface is hooks/config.js (snapshotted by split-export-compat.test.js); leaf-module exports are closer to test-only internals.
findings.resolution: Clarified: helpers are leaf-module exports only (NOT added to config.js, so split-export-compat.test.js is untouched). Re-grounded the 3.11.0 rationale on the new observable log-line contract rather than new public API; noted 3.10.1 as an acceptable operator override. Added a Files-to-Modify export-scope note and a Risk Areas note.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep helpers leaf-only; ground the version on the log-line feature; or re-export through config.js + update the snapshot if 3.11.0 must rest on public API.

findings.description: Round 2: isQueuedWhileUnarmed repeatedly called 'pure', but it delegates to deriveListenerState which reads Date.now() and process.kill(pid,0) — deterministic but not pure.
findings.resolution: Reworded to 'small exported helper'/'deterministic for a given (manifest, clock, liveness)' across Architecture, Implementation Strategy, and the AC; computeOldestMsgAgeMs (genuinely pure) keeps the 'pure' label.
findings.suggestedFix: Use 'small helper'/'deterministic' wording or inject clock/liveness.

findings.description: Round 2: the existing crews AGENTS.md 'Version layout' section is stale (says 5 files, omits .codex-plugin/plugin.json) while bump-version.js + version.test.js cover 6 stamps; leaving it stale preserves misleading release guidance.
findings.resolution: Added an explicit task to correct the stale 'Version layout' section to the 6-stamp reality in US-004, the Files-to-Modify AGENTS.md entry, and the version AC.
findings.suggestedFix: Update the Version layout section to 6 files in the same edit.

findings.description: Round 2: the failure-seam AC was too loose. appendMailboxWithSender calls the module-LOCAL appendLog binding, so monkey-patching the exported appendLog would not exercise the new call; a runtime failure test would mislead.
findings.resolution: Tightened the AC to require a source assertion that the new appendLog call site is inside a local try/catch, noting a runtime failure test would need an injectable logging seam (out of scope).
findings.suggestedFix: Specify a source-level try/catch assertion or an injectable logging seam.

findings.description: Round 2: US-003 ran the full suite before US-004's version/docs edits while the final AC requires the suite to pass after all edits; should explicitly rerun node tests/run.js after the version bump.
findings.resolution: US-004 step 4 and the full-suite AC now explicitly require re-running node tests/run.js as the final gate after the version + docs edits.
findings.suggestedFix: Rerun the full suite after the version bump + docs edits.

findings.description: Round 2: the stdout key-set AC should name expected key sets per envelope type and account for sessionId being omitted by JSON.stringify when undefined, to avoid brittle key comparisons across env/no-env variants.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the stdout AC to enumerate the {type:'messages'} and {type:'timeout'} key sets explicitly and to tolerate sessionId presence/absence.
findings.suggestedFix: Name per-type key sets; tolerate optional sessionId.
